title: TEA-Lab/TwoByTwo
abstract:
[CVPR 2025]🌷This is the official repository of "Two by Two✌️ : Learning Multi-Task Pairwise Objects Assembly for Generalizable Robot Manipulation"

# [Two by Two✌️ : Learning Multi-Task Pairwise Objects Assembly for Generalizable Robot Manipulation](https://tea-lab.github.io/TwoByTwo/) Project Page | arXiv | Twitter | Dataset Yu Qi* , Yuanchen Ju* , Tianming Wei , Chi Chu , Lawson L.S. Wong , Huazhe Xu **CVPR, 2025** # 🛠️ Installation This project is tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 11.8. - Install [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/docs/getting-started/anaconda/install#macos-linux-installation:to-download-a-different-version) or [Miniconda](https://www.anaconda.com/docs/getting-started/miniconda/install#linux-terminal-installer) - Clone the repository and create the environment. The environment should be installed correctly within minutes. - (Optional) If you would like to calculate Chamfer Distance, clone the [CUDA-accelerated Chamfer Distance library](https://github.com/ThibaultGROUEIX/ChamferDistancePytorch/tree/master): ## 🧩 Dataset 2BY2 Dataset has been released. To obtain our dataset, please fill out this [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfhPcAdky8ZojjPlSSHN4ubYqc7WHIwfiqFW2L5YpqAHbbVgg/viewform?usp=sharing). [News] 🆕Sep-29-2025: We have fixed some mis-match problems in the dataset and update the new mesh in the original link. ## 🍰 Dataset Utility Support It is recommended to use our pre-generated point cloud. In the meantime, you can also generate your own point cloud, add your own data, or generate **URDF(Unified Robot Description Format)** file for robot simulation purpose, please see `data_util` folder for more detailed instructions. ## 🐰Training and Inference In `src/config` modify the path of `log_dir` `data root_dir`. We support Distributed Data Parallel Training. - Train Network B - Train Network A - Inference # 🎟️ Licence This repository is released under the MIT license. abstract_zh: 本文提出了“Two by Two”方法，用于学习多任务成对物体装配，以实现泛化的机器人操作。该方法在CVPR 2025上发表，并提供了官方代码库、项目页面和数据集。我们发布了2BY2数据集，并支持点云生成、URDF生成等功能。训练和推理支持分布式数据并行。代码基于SE3-part-assembly开发，并采用MIT许可证。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出Two by Two框架，通过两阶段网络（Network A和B）学习多任务成对物体装配，支持点云输入和URDF仿真，实现通用机器人操作。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人物体装配方法通常针对单一任务，泛化能力不足，难以处理多任务成对物体装配场景。


# 二、方法

> 提出Two by Two框架，通过两阶段网络（Network A和B）学习多任务成对物体装配，支持点云输入和URDF仿真，实现通用机器人操作。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 该工作被CVPR 2025接收，并开源了2BY2数据集、代码及URDF生成工具，但摘要未给出具体量化性能指标，需参考论文原文。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与机器人装配任务直接相关。其开源数据集和两阶段学习思路可借鉴，但需要注意其缺乏与基线方法的定量对比，泛化性能有待进一步验证。
